title: Wetour Robotics Pursues Warehouse Robotics Cooperation to Support Orchestra Deployment
excerpt: Wetour Robotics (NASDAQ:WETO) is seeking a warehouse robotics cooperation agreement to support deployments of its Orchestra platform, with management estimat...
content_html:
Fiona Craig

Mon, July 27, 2026 at 10:37 AM EDT 2 min read

Wetour Robotics (NASDAQ:WETO) is seeking a warehouse robotics cooperation agreement to support deployments of its Orchestra platform, with management estimating the full contemplated project rollout could generate approximately $5 million in project-level gross profit if all required agreements and project milestones are completed.

Key Investor Takeaways

  • Wetour Robotics (NASDAQ:WETO) is pursuing a cooperation agreement with a warehouse automation and logistics robotics company.

  • Management estimates the full contemplated rollout could generate approximately $5 million in project-level gross profit.

  • The proposed partner would support implementation of the company's previously announced multi-site Orchestra commercial project.

  • The estimated gross profit excludes corporate expenses and is contingent on customer site approvals, project completion, acceptance, and payment.

  • No definitive cooperation agreement has been executed, and the estimate is preliminary and unaudited.

Why WETO Stock Is In Focus

Wetour Robotics announced that its wholly owned U.S. subsidiary, Wetour Travel Tech LLC, is negotiating a cooperation agreement with a warehouse automation and logistics robotics company to support deployments of its Orchestra Physical AI platform.

If finalized, the implementation partner would provide robotic system integration, hardware deployment, onsite implementation, worker onboarding, and technical support for the company's previously announced multi-site commercial project.

Based on the currently contemplated project scope and cost assumptions, management estimates the complete rollout could generate approximately $5 million in project-level gross profit. The company said this figure represents estimated project revenue less direct hardware, integration, deployment, logistics, onboarding, and support costs, excluding corporate overhead, taxes, interest, stock-based compensation, and other company-level expenses.

However, Wetour emphasized that no cooperation agreement has been signed and that the estimate assumes all contemplated customer sites are separately authorized, completed, accepted, and paid for.

Why This Matters For Investors

The announcement outlines a potential framework for scaling Orchestra deployments by adding an implementation partner with warehouse robotics expertise. If completed, the partnership could improve Wetour's ability to execute larger commercial projects while reducing the operational complexity of multi-site deployments.

At the same time, investors should note that the projected $5 million figure is not contracted revenue or expected net income. Management specifically stated that it is a preliminary estimate of project-level gross profit based on assumptions that remain subject to negotiations, customer approvals, project execution, and final acceptance.

Wetour Robotics（纳斯达克股票代码：WETO）正在寻求一项仓库机器人合作协议，以支持其 Orchestra 平台的部署，管理层估计，如果所有必需的协议和项目里程碑都完成，预期项目的全面部署将产生约 500 万美元的项目级毛利润。

主要投资者要点

  • Wetour Robotics（纳斯达克股票代码：WETO）正在寻求与一家仓库自动化和物流机器人公司达成合作协议。
  • 管理层估计，预期的全面推出将产生约 500 万美元的项目级毛利润。
  • 拟议的合作伙伴将支持该公司之前宣布的多站点管弦乐队商业项目的实施。
  • 预计毛利润不包括公司费用，并取决于客户现场批准、项目完成、验收和付款。
  • 尚未签署最终合作协议，且估算是初步且未经审计的。

为什么 WETO 股票成为焦点

Wetour Robotics 宣布，其全资美国子公司 Wetour Travel Tech LLC 正在与一家仓库自动化和物流机器人公司就一项合作协议进行谈判，以支持其 Orchestra 物理人工智能平台的部署。

如果最终确定，实施合作伙伴将为该公司之前宣布的多站点商业项目提供机器人系统集成、硬件部署、现场实施、工人入职和技术支持。

根据目前预期的项目范围和成本假设，管理层估计全面推出可产生约 500 万美元的项目级毛利润。 该公司表示，这一数字代表项目预计收入减去直接硬件、集成、部署、物流、入职和支持成本，不包括公司管理费用、税收、利息、股票薪酬和其他公司层面的费用。

不过，Wetour 强调，尚未签署任何合作协议，并且该估算假设所有预期的客户站点均已单独授权、完成、接受和付款。

为什么这对投资者很重要

该公告概述了通过添加具有仓库机器人专业知识的实施合作伙伴来扩展 Orchestra 部署的潜在框架。 如果完成，该合作伙伴关系可以提高 Wetour 执行大型商业项目的能力，同时降低多站点部署的运营复杂性。

同时，投资者应注意，预计的 500 万美元数字并非合同收入或预期净利润。 管理层特别指出，这是基于假设的项目级毛利润的初步估计，仍需经过谈判、客户批准、项目执行和最终验收。
